{{Top|leg}}
'''Dantooine cereal''' was a type of [[Cereal/Legends|cereal]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. It was served dried in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as a breakfast side dish for 2.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>
